summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market purchases of 18,700 common shares by its CEO, Dane Stevens, indirectly through a controlled entity. The shares were acquired on July 15–16, 2026, at prices of US$4.4940 per share (15,000 shares) and CAD$6.9496–6.9271 per share (3,700 shares). Following the transactions, Mr. Stevens beneficially owns 452,547 shares. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural conditions are disclosed. This is a routine insider trading disclosure with no special-situation event; no further action or arbitrage angle exists.
